name: HAD IT GONE Concept Engine Editorial Benchmark
purpose: A small human-reviewed set for comparing future concept-engine versions. This is an initial editorial benchmark, not a statistically representative sample.

decisionDefinitions.accept: The pair is a useful editorial connection as currently framed.
decisionDefinitions.reject: The evidence currently shown does not justify a useful editorial connection.
decisionDefinitions.needs-review: A potentially useful comparison exists, but it needs a specific thesis or stronger evidence before acceptance.
